people.text: Stephanie and her parents want to listen to music while skating in a city centre. They'd like to buy some skates while they're there.

Cameron and his family want to go ice skating somewhere that isn't busy. Although they'd like Cameron's young sister to have a separate place to skate safely, Cameron's a good skater and enjoys skating really fast.
Fi and her mum want to skate somewhere where they won't get wet if it rains. Fi wants a lesson with other people, and they'd like to do other activities on the ice, too.
Zoe and her family want to go skating in a beautiful location where there's entertainment for Zoe's young brother. They'd also like to see a skating show while they're there.
Leo and his family want to find somewhere for Leo to have an individual skating class. Afterwards, they'd like to sit down for something hot to eat while watching other people skating.

items.label: A
items.title: Hamley Hall
items.text: Hamley Hall's a 30 - minute train ride from the city. With its wonderful gardens by the river and fantastic ice rink, it's a perfect place for a day out. Art and sports classes are also available for kids of all ages. And in the evening, don't miss the Dance on Ice performance, with its live orchestra!

items.label: B
items.title: Langley Skating Centre
items.text: Langley Skating Centre is a good place to spend a few hours, with plenty to entertain you. You can pay for a one - to - one session - it's quite expensive, but you'll improve quickly. There's a restaurant right next to the ice rink, so you can get a good view of the action. It's open all day, although it's quieter in the afternoon.

items.label: C
items.title: City Skate
items.text: City Skate is always busy, especially at the weekends, when there's a DJ. If you're not very confident, arrange a lesson for either 30 minutes or an hour. It's fun watching people speed around the ice, and there are good restaurants just ten minutes away. Check the weather forecast, as you'll be skating in the open air.

items.label: D
items.title: Ice World
items.text: At Ice World, you can do an hour - long skating class - places are limited to ten, so book early. It's worth doing, as it'll give you confidence to join in the games organised there every day - really enjoyable! Best of all, there's a roof covering the whole skating area, so the fun never has to stop!

items.label: E
items.title: Chorley Lane
items.text: Chorley Lane, located in the centre of the Financial District, is generally quite quiet, as the area isn't a popular tourist destination. There's something for everyone, though, with a smaller area for kids, and there are fun races for experienced skaters, which is a nice option if you're skating by yourself.

items.label: F
items.title: Ice Park
items.text: Ice Park has a great central location, perfect for families wanting to explore the neighbourhood. Although the large skating area closes at 4 p.m., there's plenty going on in the evenings, too, including the theatre with its great shows, and many fantastic restaurants.

items.label: G
items.title: Devon Park
items.text: Devon Park offers great skating, and you can rent everything you need on site. If you're keen, you can get your own equipment here, too. This year, you'll be entertained by bands until late into the evening, when the trees are lit up. It's so magical that you'll forget you're in the heart of the capital!

items.label: H
items.title: Hill Road
items.text: Ice skating at Hill Road, with its spectacular views over the city, is popular with families. Special sessions are available for younger skaters, but everyone must keep to a sensible speed in the general sessions, too. There's a hot drinks machine, and the bus from the city centre stops right outside.

explanations.6: Stephanie 和父母想在市中心滑冰时听音乐，顺便买冰鞋。G 选项 “Devon Park” 位于首都中心，可现场租用或购买冰鞋，晚上有乐队表演，树木被灯光照亮，符合 “市中心、听音乐、买冰鞋” 的需求。原文 “in the heart of the capital... rent everything you need on site... entertained by bands until late” 直接对应。
explanations.7: Cameron 一家想找不拥挤的溜冰场，妹妹需安全独立区域，Cameron 作为好选手喜欢快速滑行。E 选项 “Chorley Lane” 位于金融区中心，游客少较安静，有儿童专属小区域，也有适合经验丰富者的速度竞赛，符合需求。原文 “generally quite quiet... smaller area for kids... fun races for experienced skaters” 对应 “not busy, separate place for sister, skate fast”。
explanations.8: Fi 和妈妈想找下雨不淋湿的溜冰场，Fi 想和他人一起上课，还想在冰上做其他活动。D 选项 “Ice World” 有屋顶覆盖整个滑冰区域，可预订 10 人以内的团体课程，每天组织游戏，符合 “防雨、团体课、冰上活动” 的要求。原文 “roof covering the whole skating area... hour-long skating class (places limited to ten)... games organised there every day” 直接匹配。
explanations.9: Zoe 一家想在美丽场地滑冰，为弟弟提供娱乐，同时观看滑冰表演。A 选项 “Hamley Hall” 有河边花园和冰场，晚上有《冰上舞蹈》表演（带现场管弦乐队），适合家庭娱乐，符合需求。原文 “wonderful gardens by the river... evening Dance on Ice performance with live orchestra” 对应 “beautiful location, entertainment for brother, skating show”。
explanations.10: Leo 一家想找能上个人滑冰课的地方，课后边看他人滑冰边吃热食。B 选项 “Langley Skating Centre” 提供一对一课程（虽贵但提升快），冰场旁有餐厅可观赏滑冰，符合需求。原文 “one-to-one session... restaurant right next to the ice rink, good view of the action” 对应 “individual class, hot food, watch others”。
